Question: Using the definition of the bilateral z transform F (z) = ^\infty\sum_n=-\infty f[n] z^-n, find the z - transform of f[n] = 3\delta [n+2] + 4\delta [n-1] + 2\delta [n-3].

Options: 
A. 3z^-2 + 4z^-1 + 2z^3
B. 3z^2+ 4z^-1 + 2z^-3
C. 2z^3 + 4z^-2 + 3z^-1
D. 4z^2+ 3z^-1 + 2z^-3
E. 4z^-3 + 3z^-2 + 2z^-1
F. 3z^2+ 2z^-1 + 4z^-3
G. 2z^2+ 4z^-1 + 3z^-3
H. 3z^3 + 4z + 2z^-2
I. 4z^3 + 2z + 3z^-2
J. 2z^-1 + 3z^-3 + 4z^2

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
